name: Command Deck Test Warlord
description: Fixture monster for command deck UX testing across action economy, targeting, cooldowns, and payload metadata.

special_abilities.name: Command Presence
special_abilities.description: Allied creatures within 10 feet gain advantage on fear saves while the warlord is conscious.

actions.name: Warblade Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Hooked Glaive
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) slashing damage; target speed reduced by 10 ft.

actions.name: Tactical Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Smoke Bomb
actions.description: Creates a 10-foot-radius heavily obscured smoke cloud centered on a point within 20 feet.

actions.name: Parry
actions.description: Reaction: The warlord adds 4 to AC against one melee attack that would hit it.

actions.name: Reposition
actions.description: Move up to 15 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from one marked target.

actions.name: Commanding Shout
actions.description: Up to two allied creatures within 30 feet can move 10 feet immediately.

actions.name: Breaker Burst
actions.description: Each creature in a 15-foot-radius sphere must make a DC 16 Dexterity save, taking 4d8 thunder damage on a failed save, or half on success.

actions.name: Dread Banner
actions.description: Enemies within 20 feet have disadvantage on Wisdom checks while the banner effect persists (concentration).

actions.name: Mark Prey
actions.description: Mark one creature within 60 feet; the warlord has advantage on its next weapon attack against that creature before end of turn.

actions.name: Guarded Step
actions.description: Reaction: move up to 10 feet and gain +2 AC against one triggering attack.

actions.name: Rally
actions.description: One ally within 30 feet regains 1d10 + 4 hit points.

actions.name: Pinning Shot
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit. Hit: 2d6 + 4 piercing and target must succeed on DC 15 Strength save or be restrained until end of its next turn.

actions.name: Whirl Cut
actions.description: Move up to 10 feet, then each enemy within 5 feet takes 2d8 + 5 slashing damage (Dex save 15 for half).

actions.name: Battlefield Scan
actions.description: Reveal hidden enemies within 20 feet until the end of the current turn.

actions.name: Exploit Opening
actions.description: Reaction: make one Warblade Strike against a creature that misses the warlord with a melee attack.

legendary_actions.name: Quick Slash
legendary_actions.description: The warlord makes one Warblade Strike.

legendary_actions.name: Ordered Advance
legendary_actions.description: One allied creature that can hear the warlord moves up to half its speed.

legendary_actions.name: Iron Decree
legendary_actions.description: Each enemy of the warlord within 15 feet must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom save or be frightened until end of its next turn.
